_comment: Deployment Rules for DeployPipeline — configure in the Fabric portal: Pipeline → Production stage → Deployment rules gear. Rules can't be imported from a file; this is the reference for what to enter. They are set once and re-apply on every deploy (manual or GitHub Actions).
_promotion_model: PRIMARY/SIMPLEST option. Deploy ALL items in a SINGLE pass so the Deployment Pipeline pairs them by name and rewrites internal references (including PL_Refresh_Master's activity GUIDs) to the paired Prod items. The report autobinds to the paired Prod Gold_SM. The three rules below cover the only bindings that do NOT auto-rebind, so Prod has no orphaned GUIDs or datasource names.
_optional_alternative: Option 2: move the notebook and dataflow IDs into a Variable Library (variable_library/VL_CICD_Bindings.json) so they resolve at runtime per stage, and keep only the Gold_SM parameter rule below (the semantic model is NOT a Variable Library consumer). Use this only when you want config-as-code or many items share the same IDs.
_report_note: Gold_Dashboard is built in the workspace (live connection to Gold_SM) and promotes through the deployment pipeline. It AUTOBINDS to the paired Prod Gold_SM — no rule and no Git step needed.

rules.description: REQUIRED — Gold_SM is Direct Lake on OneLake, which does NOT auto-bind (MS Learn understand-the-deployment-process) AND does NOT support a data-source rule (MS Learn direct-lake-overview limitations: 'Deployment pipeline rules to rebind data source — Not supported directly; can create a parameter expression to use in the connection string'). So rebind via a Text PARAMETER rule on the connection-string parameters (WorkspaceId/LakehouseId), NOT a data-source rule. GREYED OUT unless you are the OWNER of the cloned model — the deploying identity becomes owner; if someone/something else deployed it, take ownership in ws-CICD-Prod (Gold_SM → Settings → Take over) before the rule pane is editable. The model's connection must be parameterized first. Parameter rules must be type Text. Variable Library CANNOT rebind a semantic model.
rules.prerequisite: Parameterize the model connection: replace hard-coded Dev workspace/lakehouse GUIDs with Text parameters (WorkspaceId, LakehouseId) via TMDL/XMLA or web modeling, then deploy and take ownership.

rules.description: REQUIRED — Dataflow Gen2 connections do not auto-bind. Inject the target-stage Silver_LH IDs (Text parameters) so source/destination repoint automatically.

Deterministic override of notebook default-lakehouse auto-binding. Map each notebook's Dev default lakehouse to its matching Prod lakehouse. Code uses three-part names (name-based); without this rule, auto-bind handles it when lakehouses deploy together.

_howto: 1. Build ALL items in Dev, assign both workspaces to the pipeline, then Deploy ONCE so every supported item auto-pairs into Prod (lakehouses, notebooks, data pipeline, dataflow, semantic model).

2. WHY deploy first: a deployment rule can only attach to an item that already EXISTS in the target stage. Before the first deploy the Production rules panel is empty. Order is always: deploy once -> set rules -> deploy again.
3. On the Production stage, click the Deployment rules (gear/lightning) icon on the item.
6. NB_01/NB_02/NB_03 -> Default lakehouse -> matching Prod lakehouse (one rule per notebook).
7. PL_Refresh_Master needs no rule — its activity GUIDs are re-paired automatically.
8. Gold_Dashboard needs no rule — the report autobinds to the paired Prod Gold_SM.
9. Deploy AGAIN so the rules apply and the Prod items repoint to Prod sources. Rules persist and re-apply on every later deploy, including GitHub Actions.
